purpose: Semantic trigger registry for cross-module sync fan-out after a core module is finished. Maps changed-paths + keywords + entity diffs to a SMALL set of reusable sync actions. This is NOT a fixed 9-lane pipeline; it is a rule table consumed by the dispatcher.

hard_rules: web->app always via the D3 gate (xai-web-to-desktop-sync); never merge web directly into dev
frozen lines (site/admin PROPOSED, sync/plugin P2 PAUSED) produce receipts/drafts ONLY — never land source, never open implementation branches
creating desktop-next / desktop-plugin-next / release/* and anything touching dev are SEPARATE operator-confirmed steps
device-local entities NEVER enter the remote outbox (ADR-0013 D4)
before locking any cross-cutting design or this registry, run one independent `codex exec -s read-only` adversarial review (see ADR-0014 D5)

frozen_lines.sync: P2 PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — check receipt only, no source landing
frozen_lines.plugin: P2 PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — impact note only, no source landing

actions.title: Web->Desktop D3 parity receipt
actions.note: Reuses the existing W0-W4 classifier + handoff. W3 native delta routes to xai-feature-full-loop (NEW work, not a merge); merge-to-desktop-next + touching dev stay operator-gated.

actions.title: Account-sync D4 scope + completeness check (RECEIPT ONLY)
actions.note: MUST NOT write packages/core-data/src/entities.ts or any plugin types.ts while the sync line is paused — check + log only. Covers BOTH layers: the central map (core-data/entities.ts + RepoEntityTypeMap) AND each plugin's own entityType in packages/*/src/types.ts. Enforces device-local-never-syncs and the 9-item completeness list.

actions.title: Release-log append + dashboard/structure mirror sync (CLOSE-OUT)
actions.note: Close-out step: must run AFTER every lane that affects routing/release/dashboard/skill-surface. Two logical sub-steps with different owners: (a) release-log append (xai-release-log), (b) dashboard regen + mirror lint (xai-dev-dashboard-sync — do NOT build a new xai-structure-sync; the skill + git hooks already exist).

actions.title: Site/Admin/Plugin brief-only impact note
actions.note: One reusable action covers site / admin / plugin while they are frozen. Produces an impact note + draft only; opening codex/site|admin|plugin implementation branches requires operator unfreeze.

file_ownership.risk: repo's only changelog surface (no CHANGELOG.md); single writer prevents concurrent append conflicts
GENERATED ONLY — never hand-edit; produced by scripts/dashboard/generate-state.mjs (+ .githooks/post-merge|post-checkout|post-commit)
human-decision mirror; generator input; same owner as state.generated.js
skill mirror — single writer; run Agent/Skill Tracking audit after every change

file_ownership.owner: d4_account_sync_scope_check (CHECK-ONLY — no write while sync paused)
file_ownership.risk: central entityType/syncScope map; NOT the only registration site (see open_findings)
single writer for any future affected-graph config

dispatch.trigger_phrase: Web 版本功能已完成，执行后续同步 workflow
dispatch.mechanism: Read this registry's rules[], match against changed paths + keywords + entityType/syncScope diff. Do NOT rely on `turbo run --affected` as the only signal and do NOT fabricate a web->sync workspace dependency (web->core-data already exists transitively via @repo/plugin-console + @repo/plugin-productivity). Emit one copy-paste prompt per hit action, or spawn one worktree-pinned subagent per action.

branch_commit_merge.branch: one git worktree per action; base = origin/web; six short-branch convention codex/{web|desktop|plugin|sync|site|admin}/<feature>; copy (not symlink) .env per worktree with distinct PORT; WIP <= 5
branch_commit_merge.commit: type(scope): summary + Why/What/Scope/Risk/Docs/Tests; scope == module key; each worktree commits only its owned file set, never mixing owners (avoids the git-reset working-tree-loss pitfall)
branch_commit_merge.merge: fan-out-then-verify; converge lanes on a short-lived integration/web-sync-<date> branch, run one full check-types+lint+test, then operator-gated reconcile into main (ADR-0013 D5). web->app never merges into dev here — only the D3 receipt + handoff is produced.

open_findings.summary: core-data/entities.ts registers entityType 'clipboard.item' and the E3005 runtime guard enforces device-local keyed on 'clipboard.item', but plugin-clipboard's runtime uses 'clipboard.entry' everywhere. Two entityType strings for the same concept; the device-local guard may not actually cover the plugin's real records.
open_findings.action: First test case for d4_account_sync_scope_check; reconcile which string is canonical. Tracked in a separate spawned task — do NOT fix inline.

rollout.phase_0: Expose xai-release-log (symlink — DONE) + author this registry (DONE). No frozen-line changes.
rollout.phase_1: Build the single new skill xai-account-sync-scope-check (D4; authority = account-sync-verification-gates.md; receipt-only).
rollout.phase_2: Build xai-sync-fanout-dispatch driven by this registry's semantic rules.
rollout.phase_3: Close-out reuses xai-dev-dashboard-sync + .githooks for mirror lint; site/admin/plugin dedicated skills wait for operator unfreeze.
